title: Normalized mattress catalog entry
description: The shape every raw mattress record is normalized into by scripts/ingest-mattresses.js.

type.description: Canonical mattress type bucket required by the brief (foam / hybrid / in-spring).

coreMaterialNotes.description: Extra material detail that doesn't change the canonical type (e.g. a latex comfort layer on a hybrid).

raw.description: Original raw value, kept for auditability.

firmnessRange.description: 1-10 scale. Null when the raw source gave no parseable firmness value (see dataQualityNotes).

sourceConfidence.description: How many required fields resolved cleanly from raw data without falling back to a null/placeholder.

dataQualityNotes.description: Human-readable notes on any field that couldn't be parsed cleanly.
